concept.name: Chikou Span
concept.definition: The Ichimoku confirmation line: today's close plotted 26 periods back on the chart, so it can be compared directly with where price and the cloud stood 26 bars ago.
concept.intuition: By shifting the close into the past, you see at a glance whether the current price is above or below the price and cloud of 26 periods ago - a built-in momentum comparison.
concept.mechanics: Plot Close_t at chart position t-26. Standard confirmation rules: bullish when the Chikou is above the price of 26 bars ago (and ideally above the past cloud), bearish when below.
concept.formula: Chikou Span_t = Close_t, displayed at bar t - 26 (default displacement 26).
concept.failure_modes: It is purely a displaced close and adds no information beyond a 26-period momentum comparison; the rightmost 26 bars of any chart show no Chikou at all.
concept.misconceptions: Despite being drawn through past prices it is not a forecast line - it simply re-displays the close offset backward.
concept.example: If today's close is 105 and the close 26 bars ago was 98, the Chikou point sits above that past price - a bullish confirmation.
